sentences.text:
Smt. Purnima Sutradhar vs Sri Rahul Debnath on 5 March, 2025
 Page 1 of 2

High Court Of Tripura
 Agartala
 Tr.P.(C) No.07 of 2025
Smt. Purnima Sutradhar
 .........Petitioner(s);
 Versus
Sri Rahul Debnath
 .........Respondent(s).
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Biplab Debnath, Advocate.

HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. APARESH KUMAR SINGH Order 05/03/2025 Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of T.S. (Divorce) 103 of 2024 from the learned Family Court, Belonia,
South Tripura to the learned Family Court, Agartala, West Tripura.
The marriage between the parties was solemnized on 10.09.2020.
Allegedly petitioner was driven out of matrimonial home on 10.04.2022.
She has filed an FIR against the respondent on 14.11.2022 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Interim maintenance has been awarded in her favour vide order dated 25.04.2024 by learned Family Court, Agartala, West Tripura @ Rs.3000/- per month.
According to the petitioner, divorce petition has been filed thereafter by the respondent.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is wholly dependent upon her parents.
She does not have any independent source of income and it will be difficult for her to attend to the proceedings of the matrimonial suit at Belonia.

Petitioner has, therefore, sought transfer of T.S. (Divorce) 103 of 2024 from the learned Family Court, Belonia,
South Tripura to the learned Family Court, Agartala, West Tripura.
Issue notice upon the sole respondent under ordinary process and speed post for which requisites be filed within one week.
Notice is made returnable within five weeks.

(APARESH KUMAR SINGH), CJ Pijush/ MUNNA SAHA Digitally signed by MUNNA SAHA Date:
2025.03.06 11:33:17 +05'30'
